ms.promise:
Set up the NextJS skeleton with a front end and a back end
・Create a front-end with a sample product page for users to purchase goods
・Create a back-end that will receive and process payment confirmation from the payment processor

NextJS front and back end need to be able to connect to public Cardano indexers to monitor the status of transactions and submit new transactions. (e.g. Koios or Maestro) If a public indexer is not available, then create a docker-compose yaml files to run cardan-node, cardano-db-sync, cardano-graphql and cardano-wallet on the server to read existing transactions and to submit new transactions.
We will test the ability to use public indexers to monitor and submit transactions and only proceed to a custom docker-compose set-up if the test is not successful
The front end product page will focus on demonstrating of how to add a button "Pay with Credit Card" to a website for the client to pay for an NFT. Other features of a webshop, such as feedback forms and pricing options, are not in the scope of the proposal. ms.promise:
Create additional back-end services, outside of NextJs, to monitor the status of payments:
・A MongoDB database that keeps the status of a product throughout its life. Starting with payment initiated, to payment received, to token sent and finally, token received in the user wallet. An example MongoDB schema will be provided for the services that interact with the MongoDB to track the payment status. The code in the backend service that communicated with MongoDB using the schema will be commented.
・A back-end service that monitors the EVM chain index for transactions and confirms that payment has been received. This is in addition to the back-end service in NextJs to double-check payment confirmations and reduce the risk of fraud. Importantly that this is a redundancy backup for the NextJS backed end. ms.promise:
・Create a smart contract template that links to the policy id of assets on Cardano and into where the payment processor will transfer the payments. This will be an ERC20 token that mints a token once payment has been received. It inherits the security guarantees of an ERC20 token template.
・Guide how to launch and the smart contract on an EVM chain using Remix, how to monitor its balance and withdraw from the smart contract into the developer’s wallet. The smart contract is queried for available funds to withdraw using Remix and funds that are available can be withdrawn to an EVM wallet using Metamask.
ms.criteria:
・A template smart contract that references the asset on the Cardano blockchain. When the payment processor sends the payment to this smart contract on an EVM chain the smart contract mints a temporary token on the EVM chain and this gives a queue to send the user the token on the Cardano chain. A smart contract that has a reference to the PoliciID and Name of the asset on Carano, that accepts a payment and mints an ERC20 token.
・A tutorial with code example showing how to launch the smart contract on an EVM chain using Remixn and perform operations to retrieve funds from the smart contract
